title: Canonical expressions of the native open tensor data
statement: For a finite field k₀, a prime l different from its characteristic, and a k₀-scheme X, the left-first native tensor object function and its left map function are the object and map projections of nativeTensorBifunctor.flip; nativeTensorTotal is that bifunctor’s cochain total; nativeOpenTensorInsertion is its actual homogeneous coproduct insertion. These are equalities of the recorded constructions, including the dependent function types of the maps and insertions.

source.place: Tag 012Z, total complexes; the concrete definitions nativeTensorBifunctor, nativeTensorTotal and nativeOpenTensorInsertion in the native framework

proof.text: Unfold the object and map projections of the flipped native tensor bifunctor. Its object is tensor with the right factor first, and its left map is tensorFunctor.map. By definition nativeTensorTotal is the cochain total of that flipped bifunctor and nativeOpenTensorInsertion is its homogeneous coproduct insertion. The four equalities are reflexive as whole functions, so they hold on zero objects, empty schemes and arbitrary unbounded complexes as well.

lean.statement:
theorem native_open_tensor_canonical_data
    (k₀ : Type u) [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] :
    ((fun M N ↦ tensor k₀ l X N M) =
      fun M N ↦ (((nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X).flip.obj M).obj N)) ∧
    HEq (fun {M M' : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X} (f : M ⟶ M') N ↦
      (tensorFunctor k₀ l X N).map f)
      (fun {M M' : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X} (f : M ⟶ M') N ↦
        ((nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X).flip.map f).app N) ∧
    nativeTensorTotal k₀ l X = (nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X).flip.map₂CochainComplex ∧
    HEq (nativeOpenTensorInsertion k₀ l X)
      (fun (P T : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ) p q n h ↦
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P T (nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X).flip
          (.up ℤ) p q n h)
